# All Things Delicious

> > Singapore's premier halal catering and gifting service offering seasonal collections, corporate catering, and artisanal treats for celebrations year-round.

All Things Delicious specializes in halal-certified catering, desserts, and gift hampers for both corporate and personal occasions across Singapore. They feature seasonal collections for Ramadan, Hari Raya, Deepavali, National Day, and other celebrations, alongside everyday catering options including bentos, finger foods, and beverages.

## Key Topics

- Halal Catering Singapore
- Halal Gifts & Hampers
- Ramadan & Hari Raya Collections
- Seasonal Celebrations (National Day, Deepavali, Father's Day, Mother's Day)
- Corporate Catering & GeBiz
- Artisanal Cookies & Desserts
- Palestinian Medjoul Dates
- Party Finger Foods & Canapés
- Delivery & Pickup Service
- Gift Boxes & Hamper Baskets
- Gluten-Free Options
- Organic Kampung Chicken
- Australian Oats Products
- Tea-Time Platters

## Seasonal Collections 2025

- [National Day 2025](https://allthingsdelicious.sg/collections/national-day-2025): SG60 National Day collection celebrating Singapore's local favourites
- [Ramadan Essentials - The 2025 Selection](https://allthingsdelicious.sg/collections/ramadan-essentials-2025): Ramadan 2025 collection with dates, granola, and sahur/iftar meals
- [Raya Finger Foods - The 2025 Selection](https://allthingsdelicious.sg/collections/raya-finger-foods-2025): Raya 2025 finger foods: canapés, brownies, bomboloni for open houses
- [The Mother's Day 2025 Selection](https://allthingsdelicious.sg/collections/the-mothers-day-2025-selection): Mother's Day 2025 collection with cakes, tarts, and dessert gift boxes
- [Father's Day - The 2025 Selection](https://allthingsdelicious.sg/collections/fathers-day-the-2025-selection): Father's Day 2025 collection with cakes, choux puffs, and meal sets
